verses.text: This is the story of the family of Shem, Ham and Japheth, Noah's sons. They had sons of their own after the flood.
The sons of Japheth were Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech and Tiras.
The sons of Gomer were Ashkenaz, Riphath and Togarmah.
The sons of Javan were Elishah, Tarshish, the Kittites and the Rodanites.
From these came the peoples who spread out to the coastlands and islands. Each group lived in its own land, with its own language, by its clans within its nations.
The sons of Ham were Cush, Egypt, Put and Canaan.
The sons of Cush were Seba, Havilah, Sabtah, Raamah and Sabteca. The sons of Raamah were Sheba and Dedan.
Cush was the father of Nimrod, who became the first mighty warrior on the earth.
He was a mighty hunter in the eyes of the LORD. That is why people say, "Like Nimrod, a mighty hunter in the eyes of the LORD."
The first centres of his kingdom were Babylon, Erech, Akkad and Calneh, in the land of Shinar.
From that land he went to Assyria, where he built Nineveh, Rehoboth-Ir, Calah,
and Resen, which is between Nineveh and Calah, the great city.
Egypt was the father of the Ludites, Anamites, Lehabites, Naphtuhites,
Pathrusites, Casluhites and Caphtorites. The Philistines came from the Casluhites.
Canaan was the father of Sidon, his firstborn, and of the Hittites,
the Jebusites, the Amorites, the Girgashites,
the Hivites, the Arkites, the Sinites,
the Arvadites, the Zemarites and the Hamathites. Later the clans of the Canaanites spread out.
The borders of Canaan reached from Sidon towards Gerar as far as Gaza, and then towards Sodom, Gomorrah, Admah and Zeboiim, as far as Lasha.
These were the sons of Ham, by their clans and languages, in their lands and nations.
Sons were also born to Shem, the older brother of Japheth. Shem was the ancestor of all the sons of Eber.
The sons of Shem were Elam, Asshur, Arphaxad, Lud and Aram.
The sons of Aram were Uz, Hul, Gether and Mash.
Arphaxad was the father of Shelah, and Shelah was the father of Eber.
Eber had two sons. One was named Peleg, which means "divided", because in his time the earth was divided. His brother was named Joktan.
Joktan was the father of Almodad, Sheleph, Hazarmaveth, Jerah,
Hadoram, Uzal, Diklah,
Obal, Abimael, Sheba,
Ophir, Havilah and Jobab. All these were sons of Joktan.
The land where they lived stretched from Mesha towards Sephar, in the hill country in the east.
These were the sons of Shem, by their clans and languages, in their lands and nations.
These were the clans of Noah's sons, listed by their family lines and nations. From them the nations spread out over the earth after the flood.
